source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    rows = [r for r, c in cells]
    cols = [c for r, c in cells]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)) > h // 2]
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if sum(grid[r][c] == 0 for c in range(w)) > w // 2]
    cr = (min(horizontal) + max(horizontal)) // 2
    cc = (min(vertical) + max(vertical)) // 2
    length = len(cells)
    out = [[7] * w for _ in range(h)]
    if max(rows) - min(rows) >= max(cols) - min(cols):
        start = cr - (length - 1) // 2
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][cc - 1] = 0
            out[r][cc + 1] = 0
        for c in range(w):
            out[cr][c] = 0
        for r in range(start, start + length):
            out[r][cc] = 5
    else:
        start = cc - (length - 1) // 2
        for c in range(w):
            out[cr - 1][c] = 0
            out[cr + 1][c] = 0
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][cc] = 0
        for c in range(start, start + length):
            out[cr][c] = 5
    return out
'''
